preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= arr[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in arr is between 0 and 10^5.
There is exactly one node with parent -1, which is the root.

postconditions.description: The height of the tree is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(path) for path in all_paths_from_root)
postconditions.description: The height of the tree is the length of the longest path from the root to a leaf.
